minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, November 17, 2021
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, November 17, 2021.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Jenny Jolly, Bette
  Donovan and Scott Snider.
  Members absent: None.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.
  Guests present: None.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, October 20,
  2021. Motion carried.
  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: An average of 85 meals were distributed per week in
  October for the Grab-n-Go meals.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: There is an average of 59 people in attendance. Bingo has made
  about $300 plus gave away special prizes for Thanksgiving like gift cards and a
  raffle for $20 gifts. Finding callers continues to be a problem. There has been more
  people attending which has made more money ($2,000-$4,000), but for next year
  prices will probably increase. The current Bingo balance is $4,272.99.

5. Meals on Wheels: 689 meals were distributed in October to 35 La Verne participants
  for an average of 48 meals per day. A total of 1,008 meals were distributed in San
  Dimas and La Verne combined.

6. Account Balance: $3,025.57

7. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid except Garden Friends.

8. MT. SAC Classes: Class registration was on November 9th and there was a good
  amount of people registering. The special needs classes will add a Monday class
  and will run Monday, Wednesday and Friday. The drawing class on Wednesdays
  was eliminated in order to allow the sewing classes to remain in their same room.
 9. Aging Next: 10 La Verne residents used Case Management in October. There were
  2 meal deliveries.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Saturday, December 4th –Old Town Holiday Stroll, 4:00-6:00 PM
  Monday, December 6th –Christmas Tree Lighting, City Hall, 6:30 PM
  Monday, December 6th & 20th – International Line Dancing, Basic Beginner
  2:00-3:00 PM and Cardio Beginner 3:00-4:00 PM
  Wednesday, December 8th– Line Dancing, Beginner Class 2:00-3:00 PM and
  Intermediate Class 3:00-4:00 PM
  Saturday, December 11th –Winter Wonderland, Heritage Park, 9:00 AM-1:00 PM
  Wednesday, December 15th– Line Dancing, Beginner Class 2:00-3:00 PM and
  Intermediate Class 3:00-4:00 PM

11. Facilities Report: All repairs are done and LED lights will be added to the hallways at
  Veterans Hall. The Senior Lounge is closed still due to COVID. There is currently a
  transition in decor happening from Fall to Christmas at the Community Center.

12. Public Comments: George gave his golf update and shared he won 2 trophies.
  Golf’s had about 20 people attending at Marshall Canyon and will end on December
  14th. The Club Champions tournament is set for the 23rd and 30th.
  Scott updated the group on Hillcrest and shared that the dining room is still closed.
  There is also a mandated vaccine requirement.
  Amanda informed the group that Paulina is leaving mid-January. There is currently a
  Recreation Leader for sports being hired. Mah-Jong may come back but is not
  definite. Starting in January a creativity class will begin that will make jewelry, knit
  and crochet. The Community Center maybe offering the COVID vaccine booster
  shot.

13. Adjourn: A motion was moved to adjourn the meeting at 11:00 AM, motion
  approved and carried. Next meeting will be held at the Community Center on
  January 19, 2022 at 10:00 AM. There is no meeting in December.
